description: §42.4 / §63.5 — the canonical twin of condition/given-presence-deprecated-guard: each in-place `given` guard written as the explicit presence test (`if (name is given)`, `if (name is given && age is given)`, `if (empty is given)`). It reaches the SAME state as the deprecated form and surfaces no W-GIVEN-PRESENCE-DEPRECATED — the pair is the §63.5 runtime-identity assertion for the window.
rationale: §42.2.4 — `x is given` is the explicit presence test, true when x is not `not` ("" is present, §42.1.1); §42.4 statement 7 — a compound spells presence explicitly (`x is given && y is given`). §63.5 — the deprecated `given` guard's runtime is identical to this canonical form's. Provenance: ruling:user-voice-scrml.md S462 "a, go" (the rewrite target), S460 "a′, go" (the explicit pair).
